description: This file implements the rx::TextureStorage9 class and its derived classes for managing D3D9 textures, including 2D textures, cube textures, and EGLImage-based textures, with functions for surface retrieval, mipmap generation, and copying between storages.

classes.name: TextureStorage9
classes.description: Abstract base class for D3D9 texture storage, providing interface for usage, format, and data management.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_2D
classes.description: Concrete class for 2D texture storage in D3D9, supporting surface access, mipmap generation, and copying.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_Cube
classes.description: Concrete class for cube map texture storage in D3D9, supporting surface access, mipmap generation, and copying.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_EGLImage
classes.description: Texture storage backed by an EGLImage, supporting surface retrieval and storage copying.

methods.name: GetTextureUsage
methods.description: Determines D3D usage flags based on internal format and render target status.

methods.name: isRenderTarget
methods.description: Checks if the texture storage is configured as a render target.

methods.name: isManaged
methods.description: Checks if the texture pool is managed.

methods.name: supportsNativeMipmapFunction
methods.description: Indicates if native mipmap functions are supported (returns false).

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of mipmap levels.

methods.name: getSurfaceLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the surface for a specific mipmap level.

methods.name: getRenderTarget
methods.description: Gets or creates a render target for a specific level or face.

methods.name: getBaseTexture
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the base D3D texture object.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies texture data to another TextureStorage9 object.
